_comment: Copy to config/dev.json and fill in. dev.json is git-ignored. Run with: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=config/dev.json
_auth_redirect_note: The Supabase project's Auth > URL Configuration > Redirect URLs allow-list must include 'finroot://auth-callback' for the password-reset link to open the app. This is an additive dashboard setting with no web impact (M3 report).
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: <the anon / publishable key - NEVER the service_role key>
